source='''def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    colored_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row)]
    if not colored_rows:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    bottom = max(colored_rows)
    out = [[0 for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        shift = r - bottom
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            nc = c + shift
            if value != 0 and 0 <= nc < cols:
                out[r][nc] = value
    return out
'''
